purpose: One option row in the Combobox list, with an optional leading icon, a description, a trailing value and a check on the selected row.

notFor.case: Standalone use outside a Combobox list.
An action row in a menu.
A suggestion row of a tag field.

Default.visual: No fill; label and icon in Content/primary, description and trailing in Content/secondary.

Focused.visual: Surface/muted fill with a Border/focus edge and Border/ring/default halo.

Selected.visual: Surface/selected fill with the check in Content/accent.

Disabled.visual: Icon, label, description and trailing in Content/disabled.

a11y.keyboard: Not a tab stop; the Combobox field moves the active option with Arrow Up / Down and Enter picks it.
notes: Fill and edge move with use-hover; the halo with use-focus.

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the row's fill and halo transitions be instant with reduced motion?
Disabled: the check keeps Content/accent on a disabled row. Intended, or should it take Content/disabled too?
